# Library

> A catalog of 436 works in 15 collections in this repository. Each record has a permanent accession number, a link to its plate, its source file, and its technique and atom terms.

## Data

- [Catalog](catalog.json): records, technique and atom terms with the records that use them, see-also links, audit.
- [Accession register](accessions.json): record id to accession number.
- [Fixity](fixity.json): sha256 of each source file at build time.

## Collections

- [Encyclopedia](../encyclopedia/): 176 records. Techniques, atoms, explorations and couplings in one manifest. Source: `encyclopedia/manifest.js + content/<id>/entry.js`.
- [Techniques & Templates](../techniques-templates/): 22 records. Measured studies and templates. Each study has a spec. Source: `techniques-templates/_shared/entries.js + techniques/<id>/spec.json`.
- [Technique Studies](../technique-studies/): 11 records. Standalone read plates, the earlier form of the Techniques & Templates studies. Source: `technique-studies/st-NN-*.html (window.STUDY inside each plate)`.
- [Printed Matter](../printed-matter-studies/): 18 records. Paper-and-ink studies on one page, each at its own anchor. Source: `printed-matter-studies/index.html (one page, one builder per study)`.
- [Single studies](../gallery/): 3 records. One-page studies that belong to no series. Source: `<folder>/index.html + tool.json`.
- [Instruments](../): 4 records. Working tools. Source: `<folder>/index.html + tool.json`.
- [MASSIVE](https://jalulia.github.io/massive/): 17 records. The MASSIVE hub: match statistics, explorations, reference motion, screensavers. Source: `github.com/jalulia/massive`.
- [Mad Money Tycoon](https://jalulia.github.io/RCT-MM/): 12 records. The game, its design document, sprite catalogue and exploration archive. Source: `github.com/jalulia/RCT-MM`.
- [Desktop Bo](https://jalulia.github.io/bo/): 15 records. The desktop pet: design document, playable builds, sprite tests. Source: `github.com/jalulia/bo`.
- [Mode Mode](https://jalulia.github.io/modemode/): 3 records. The field studio site and its About studies. Source: `github.com/jalulia/modemode`.
- [Reliquary](https://jalulia.github.io/holy-ops-v2/): 4 records. Holy Ops, the relic exchange terminal and the synth. Source: `github.com/jalulia/holy-ops-v2, relic-grid, reliquary-synth`.
- [Other sites](.): 39 records. One-page sites in their own repositories. Source: `github.com/jalulia/<repo>`.
- [Garden](.): 5 records. The garden system and its studies. Source: `Claude artifacts, local files`.
- [Loose studies](.): 95 records. Single pieces with no series: plates lifted from pages that are not online. Source: `Claude artifacts, local files`.
- [Held](.): 12 records. Work that is not on the deployed site: staged patches, proposals, and plates on the working machine. Source: `library/_build/holdings.json (hand-kept)`.

## Specs

- [TS-01 Moiré from two ring screens](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-01-moire-ring-screens/spec.json): Two concentric-ring gratings multiplied, dithered with grain, one hot core.
- [TS-02 Four-ink spot illustration](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-02-four-ink-spot-illustration/spec.json): Flat spot fills, a black keyline, hatched shading, slipped register, cream stock.
- [TS-03 Iridescent chrome on black](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-03-iridescent-chrome/spec.json): A bent slab shaded by a spectral gradient across its normals, film grain, split-channel wordmarks.
- [TS-04 Stacked card scroll](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-04-stacked-card-scroll/spec.json): Rounded cards that pin and stack as the page scrolls; each card a different ground.
- [TS-05 Vertical line-screen type](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-05-line-screen-type/spec.json): Heavy serif type printed through a vertical line screen; line width follows a phase field.
- [TS-06 Riso three-plate separation](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-06-riso-plate-separation/spec.json): Yellow, blue and fluorescent pink plates on an isometric drawing; each plate mis-registers and grains on its own.
- [TS-07 Gradient-mapped blur type](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-07-gradient-map-blur-type/spec.json): Heavy type and a blob field blurred together, then mapped through a four-stop ramp; the blur breathes.
- [TS-08 Flat-color card set](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-08-flat-color-card-set/spec.json): Six rounded cards, one flat color each, condensed display type at two scales, mono metadata at the edges.
- [TS-09 Grain gradient layers](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-09-grain-gradient-layers/spec.json): Soft-edged shapes over two-stop gradients, a rippled band, and one film grain over everything.
- [TS-10 Thermal blob field](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-10-thermal-blob-field/spec.json): A blurred blob field mapped through a ramp with a dark rim stop, on paper with tooth.
- [TS-11 Worn black box](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-11-worn-black-box/spec.json): A black board box, front and back, with edge scuff, creases, a cream flap, stickers and a barcode block.
- [TS-12 Perforated stamp](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-12-perforated-stamp/spec.json): A red stamp with a scalloped perforation, a halftoned serif title running up the edge, and a script credit.
- [TS-13 ASCII glyph-field animations](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-13-glyph-field-animation/spec.json): Monospace glyphs as particles — a projected helix with palette labels, a sine wave grid, a breathing orbit and a pulse row, all fillText.
- [T-03 Strategy deck](../techniques-templates/templates/t-03-strategy-deck/template.json): A strategy-deck template — 29 layouts on a fixed 1600 × 900 stage, one per slide with a usage note (N), generated image slots, and a machine-readable template.json.
- [TS-14 Deep Space Chroma · birefringence](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-14-deep-space-chroma/spec.json): A crossed-polar photoelastic model — a retardation field and a slow-axis field read through a spectral Michel-Lévy chart.
- [TS-15 Banknote engraving](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-15-banknote-engraving/spec.json): A picture reprinted as one-ink intaglio: swelling lines, shadow crosshatch, lines that bend with the form, guilloche in the smooth upper areas, one kept hue as a second ink.
- [TS-16 Stipple bank and dot burst](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-16-stipple-cloud-bank/spec.json): One jittered dot lattice. Tone fields keep or drop each dot: a burst on the sky, a dense rim on dark banks, wisps inside light ones. The same field prints a one-pixel wash.
- [TS-17 Warped ring cells](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-17-warped-ring-cells/spec.json): A grid of rounded cells on a sheet pulled at four points, inked by thirteen pools that fill cells, outline them or fill the gutters. Every pixel is one ink or stock; nothing is blurred.
- [TS-19 Arc bundles on a dashed globe](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-19-arc-bundle-field/spec.json): Bundles of thin arcs leave one hub as a trunk and fan apart, colored along their length and added where they cross, over dashed meridians with numbered nodes.
- [TS-22 Capsule rain system](../techniques-templates/techniques/ts-22-capsule-rain/spec.json): One field of rounded capsules in columns, growing along an axis with five inks in bands. Used full, sparse, clipped to a ring and inside hairline frames, with tracked mono labels.
